soundness_flags.label: ass:treatment-fit-radius and ass:outcome-fit-radius / def:jms-joint-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The membership class is defined by performance of the named fitted procedures \(\widehat g,\widehat q\), rather than primitive properties of a law; state existence of fits attaining the radii (with the selected fits supplied as construction inputs) or formulate a conditional-on-fits experiment outside the law class.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 4 and 8, Theorems 3.2 and 5.4; pp. 58--59, Corollary G.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 3.2 gives a Gaussian-treatment structure-agnostic lower bound with \((\log(1/\varepsilon_g)/\log n)^3\); Theorem 5.4 gives fixed-positive-cumulant ACE point-estimation bounds, and Corollary G.1 gives the cubic fourth-cumulant score.
Theorem 5 establishes the Gaussian obstruction to second-order orthogonal PLR moments; Theorems 8--9 construct non-Gaussian moments and Theorem 10 gives the high-dimensional implementation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the two procedure-specific radius membership conditions by primitive/existential law-side estimability conditions, then make the realized certified fits explicit inputs to the split-sample construction.

Specify a simultaneous error allocation or joint concentration event for the DML fallback, Appell inversion, and branch-selection event, so the advertised \(1-\alpha\) union honesty is operational rather than delegated to an unspecified \(K_\alpha\).
Promote the fuzzy-Hermite handle to a proved two-prior lower bound over the same conditional-on-fit experiment; this would turn the current one-sided upper result into a sharp branchwise frontier.

recommended_next_step: Revise the law-versus-procedure class definition and explicitly calibrate simultaneous coverage, then advance the repaired field-tier upper-frontier target to Stage 0.
